scope: Targeted primary-provider and original data-descriptor metadata review; not an exhaustive systematic review.
requirements: Original or provider-authorized clinical structural whole-brain T1 MRI
Patient-level AD/control diagnoses and stable subject identities
No institutional login, form, data-use application or approval needed
Additional source beyond already used Besga, OpenNeuro clinical release and Harvard Dataverse29352
prior_review_reused: MIRIAD: registration/data-use route remains unresolved for unrestricted access
BrainLat: provider permission and institutional access information required in prior check
NeuGRID cohorts: registration and dataset agreements
BioFIND: MCI/control rather than diagnosed AD/control
AlzaSet: acquired but quarantined without verified subject mapping; not used for fitting or prediction
OASIS: previously documented institutional access gate; no mirror used to evade provider requirements

new_candidates.provider: Sage Bionetworks Synapse / original AddNeuroMed investigators
new_candidates.imaging: Descriptor states raw longitudinal 1.5T T1 MRI plus FreeSurfer measures are provided.
new_candidates.identity: Descriptor documents unified participant identifiers and mapping back to raw modalities, with AD/MCI/control diagnoses. Total 1702 is the multimodal cohort, not a verified available MRI denominator.
new_candidates.license_and_access: Original descriptor requires Synapse registration, signed data-use certificate, research proposal and ethical-review confirmation. Anonymous current file permission could not be verified; public project title alone does not authorize download.
new_candidates.decision: Not eligible under no-login/no-forms requirement; strongest additional scientific lead only if the access constraint is later changed.

new_candidates.license: CC0 in provider dataset_description.json; article permission is distinct from dataset access.
new_candidates.identity: BIDS subject/session identities and structural MPRAGE T1 MRI documented.
new_candidates.endpoint: Normal cognition required; older participants screened to exclude MCI and dementia. Amyloid-positive cognitively unimpaired participants are not diagnosed AD cases.
new_candidates.access: Imaging/cognitive BIDS data are public; individual demographics require institution-signed DUA.
new_candidates.decision: Not a diagnosed AD/control cohort. Possible later separately prespecified normal-aging or preclinical biomarker research only; no acquisition or use now.

new_candidates.identity: Public BIDS participant metadata; neuroimaging subgroup 79.
new_candidates.endpoint: Provider describes healthy middle-aged participants at genetic risk, not diagnosed AD/control groups.
new_candidates.decision: Wrong clinical endpoint. Do not turn genetic risk into AD labels; T1 payload completeness not pursued after endpoint exclusion.

new_candidates.identity: Subject membership described in provider README; no subject rows copied here.
new_candidates.endpoint: Main study 40 healthy participants, plus separately listed discarded participants.
new_candidates.decision: Healthy-only; not AD/control. License and full imaging inventory not pursued after endpoint exclusion.

new_candidates.provider: Simula / University of Oslo / Oslo University Hospital investigators
new_candidates.identity: One healthy-appearing volunteer repeatedly scanned before/after intrathecal tracer.
new_candidates.imaging: T1-weighted and other MRI plus derived tracer/concentration data.
new_candidates.decision: Single-volunteer tracer experiment, not a clinical AD/control cohort. Repeated acquisitions cannot be counted as independent patients; license not pursued after endpoint exclusion.

new_candidates.imaging: Public record describes 86 low-field scans and 11 paired high-field scans, with T1 among modalities; these are scan counts, not a verified independent patient denominator.
new_candidates.endpoint: Healthy-subject MRI, as named by provider.
new_candidates.decision: Wrong clinical endpoint. Could be a future dedicated acquisition-shift study with a new protocol, not additional AD cases or evidence of AD discrimination. Current record points to a newer version; not acquired.

unresolved_search_leads.status: Provider record/API could not be resolved by available tools; not treated as usable evidence or an eligible cohort.
Search index described derived two-dimensional dementia images and restricted files; provider page unavailable on direct read, so no positive provenance/access claim or acquisition made.

boundary: Do not add healthy-only sources as the control class against AD from another site: diagnosis and source would be confounded. Do not adapt the current selected models or thresholds using held-out outcomes. Any future training-source expansion and hyperparameter comparison needs a new frozen patient/source partition with validation-only selection and an untouched final source.
